hooks.text: An entire exoplanet is made almost entirely of pure diamond.
A dead star lost ninety-nine percent of its mass to a pulsar.
This planet orbits its host star every two hours.

title: The Planet Made of Diamond
description: Discover PSR J1719-1438 b, an exoplanet made of crystalline carbon orbiting a millisecond pulsar.

beats.text: An entire exoplanet is made almost entirely of pure diamond.
beats.visual: Artist concept of a diamond planet orbiting a pulsar, 2011

beats.text: In 2011, astronomers using the Parkes radio telescope detected something very strange four thousand light-years away.
beats.visual: The Parkes Radio Telescope in Australia, 2011

beats.text: The signal came from a millisecond pulsar rotating ten thousand times every minute.
beats.visual: Illustration of a millisecond pulsar with radiation beams

beats.text: This tiny stellar corpse has a mass one point four times that of the Sun.
beats.visual: Artist concept of a white dwarf star

beats.text: Circling that pulsar is a planet completing an orbit every two hours and ten minutes.
beats.visual: Diagram of the planet's orbit fitting inside the Sun
queries: size comparison of sun and planetary orbits diagram

beats.text: The entire system is so compact it would fit entirely inside our Sun.
beats.visual: Diagram of stellar system size compared to the Sun

beats.text: This world is actually the remnant of a star that lost over ninety-nine percent of its mass.
beats.visual: Artist concept of binary star system mass transfer
queries: binary star system mass transfer artist concept

beats.text: That stolen core is twenty times denser than Jupiter and compressed into crystalline carbon.
beats.visual: Molecular structure of diamond crystal lattice

better_than_last: This episode applies a concise structural mystery setup and sharp beat pacing to sustain high engagement without technical jargon.
